issues.reason: The Ordinal scale slot holds a class-level ordering symbol — the event lemma ((Ordinal priya 1 respond)) or a dimension ((Ordinal x 3 tall)) — so the individual witness sk_operation_1 there breaks the standing discipline that an individual must never occupy a class position, and no lemma-built query would match it.

gaps_confirmed: what else projects out of a seal alongside a definite NP's typing atom — the rule names only the Member / Name typing, so (Possession sk_service_1 apple_computer) and (Member sk_service_1 new) stay sealed and the service's ownership is recorded nowhere at top level
"during" with a time-period NP as its object ("during its first week of operation") — During is defined as nesting one eventuality inside another, and a week is not an eventuality

an anaphoric definite supplying a kind for an already-named referent ("the company" -> apple_computer) — coreference is pure symbol reuse, so whether to add (Member apple_computer company) is unspecified
new_gaps: the Ordinal scale slot cannot be individuated — with the lemma required there, "its first week of OPERATION" loses whose operation is being ranked, and no licensed form says the week is the first of this service's operation
repair_summary: Replaced the witness in the Ordinal scale slot with the event lemma: (Ordinal sk_week_1 1 operation). Nothing else changed.
notes: The reified sk_operation_1 state (class atom + Experiencer) is left in place as the referent of "of operation", now unlinked to the Ordinal — that loss is recorded as a new gap. Separately and unflagged, the possessive-marked definite "its first week" would by the seal-projection rule put (Member sk_week_1 week) at top level, but no confirmed issue names it so it is untouched.
